title: Take the Queen With Check
setup: Your king on h2 has Black's queen on h6, rook on g3 and bishop on c6 bearing down on it.
hint: The obvious move is to save yourself. Try the capture that changes whose king is in the net.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxh6+}} takes the queen with check; {{Kg4}} is forced, and {{Rf4#}} mates with the rook cutting the fourth rank. Removing the attacker and gaining a tempo are the same move here.
